scale_definition: 1 = peace. 5 = active gray-zone/hybrid conflict. 10 = open Russia-NATO/EU war.
credibility_scale: 1 = unverified/single unreliable source. 10 = confirmed by 10+ independent outlets.

tiers.name: Tier 3 - Interested-Party Press
tiers.note: flag for bias, cross-check against Tier 1/2

tiers.name: Excluded - Russian State Media & Unverified Accounts
tiers.note: never enters the credibility-weighted evidence base; tracked separately for narrative-pattern purposes only

byline_scoring_rules.principle: Evidence-only. Every score change must cite what it is based on. No subjective 'seems truthful' judgments.
signals: correction formally attached to this byline (negative, but transparency-partial-credit if self-initiated quickly)
claims later contradicted by independent Tier 1/2 reporting without the author correcting (negative, no partial credit)
claims confirmed by subsequent independent reporting (positive)

outlet_transparency_rules.principle: Separate from the static tier score. Tracks how an outlet handles being wrong.
signals: prompt, visible correction issued -> transparency score up
silent edit with no correction note -> transparency score down
claim contradicted by others and left uncorrected -> transparency score down
